Communication between processes

Two models

* Shared memory
** More common in games
** Faster but limited to one machine
* Message passing
** Can be used between multiple machnies

== Message passing ==
two approaches

* direct communication
* indirect communication
** sockets

=== Synchronization ===
Message passing can be blocking (synchronous) or non-blocking (asynchronous)
